reset.intro: Start a brand-new year in Paisapur? You'll wake up on your birthday again, in a new world with different luck.
reset.lost: This year's money, goals, badges, Money Journal, What-If lives and checkpoints will be erased.
reset.kept: Your player, picture-PIN and sound settings stay. Everything you learnt stays in your head!
reset.really: Are you sure? This can't be undone.
